title: Dell Secure Connect Gateway - Virtual Edition, versions prior to 5.36.00.16, contains a Heap-based… (CVE-2026-80507)
description: Dell Secure Connect Gateway - Virtual Edition versions prior to 5.36.00.16 contain a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability. This flaw allows an unauthenticated local attacker to potentially cause cache poisoning and denial of service conditions. The vulnerability has a high severity rating with a CVSS score of 8.4.
